>> This game is incredibly difficult with little to no hand holding. Enter at your own risk. << 

Nominee for "Sleeper Hit" in the 7th Annual Bloxy Awards. 

Rogue Lineage is a fantasy game with roguelike elements. The game revolves around a permadeath mechanic, where each of your characters will have but a few lives before they die forever. You'll pass down some pieces of yourself to your heir, who'll become your next character. Players will progress by learning new abilities and trying to best their previous characters. Forge houses with your friends to take control of cities, or stick it out alone. Tackle injuries, diseases, and trauma as you struggle to survive in this testament to pain.

There are more than 100 badges to be won from around this beautiful Victorian city.  Can you clear the rats from the courtyard and pick up pure from the streets, to earn some money for food?

Embark on an epic journey through the War Seas, taking part in the conflicts of kingdoms and organizations striving for power. Many will die, but only the strong survive in this harsh, magic-polluted world. 

Conflicts are high as the many kingdoms wage war over possession of Curses, powerful artifacts which grant the user immortality and great power. controls 
LMB - shoot (repair in build mode) 
RMB - aim (damage in build mode) 
E - melee 
G (5-6) - grenade 
R - reload (hold to rotate in build mode) 
Q - cycle sights 
V - cycle firing mode 
T - toggle/cycle all attachment modes 
F - interact 
`/~ - free mouse/manual attachment mode toggle (open buildable menu in build mode) 
B - enter build mode 
shift - sprint 

Paid access price will lower as development milestones are reached. Your cash will be reset & levels/weapons records will be reduced by 80% once the game fully releases.

Halloween event is out!
Every 5 rounds won, you can vote to play an event round with others.
Beating the event rounds will reward you with event flags (most of the time).
This event is harder than usual, and it's recommended to play with multiple people.

You can customize the board in private servers! (Note that wins don't count in them)
If you don't want to beat the tutorial, you can either skip it temporarily or play in a private server.
Exploiting of any sorts is NOT allowed in this game, and you will be punished for it.

How to play:
The board is divided into tiles, with mines randomly distributed.
To win, you need to step on all the safe tiles, without stepping on a mine.
The number on a tile shows the number of mines around it in a 3x3 area.
Using this information, you can determine tiles that are safe, and tiles that contain mines.
Tiles suspected of being mines can be marked with a flag using the left mouse button.

"You are going nowhere but to hell... I hope you like it there."

Examination is a PvE horror shooter, where you're tasked to clear a highly irradiated nuclear power plant that's turned into a laboratory in the wake of the WE-30 outbreak, a nation-spanning infection that, while not indiscriminate, has swallowed select zones and regions whole, reducing them to heavily quarantined White-Zones.

7+ graphics are recommended.
Best played on a private server
The controls are laid out on the screen at the class lockers
The game is challenging and you are expected to falter in the beginning, don't give up!

🦈 Welcome to Fisch 🦈

Dive into Fisch, the ultimate fishing adventure where exploration and progression are yours to control. Cast your line to catch rare and unique fish, each with 400,000+ possible variations. Explore a growing world with your trusty rod, and maybe even reel in some new friends along the way!

[How To Fish]
• Hold down to cast your bobber
• Await a bite. You can "shake" your rod to attract fish faster
• When you have a bite, hold down or click to pull the white bar. Follow the blue line to the best of your ability; it's okay to mess up a few times!
• When the progress bar on the bottom is full, you'll reel in your catch!
